services.title: Websites
services.description: Fast, mobile-friendly websites with clear pages, enquiry forms and SEO set up from day one. I have built them for real estate firms, an accounting firm, a marketing agency and a vehicle service center.

services.title: Web apps and admin panels
services.description: Booking systems, enquiry and lead management, dashboards and internal tools that replace spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups. Enquiro, my lead management system, runs at every real estate client I work with.

services.title: Mobile apps
services.description: Android and iOS apps from one codebase with React Native. I built the Book An Artist app, which is live on Google Play and the Apple App Store.

services.title: SaaS products
services.description: Software you can sell to many customers, with separate data for each organization, user roles and payments. I built core parts of HiGalen, a healthcare SaaS used by 500+ doctors, and my own products Enquiro and Coworkspace.

services.title: Integrations and AI features
services.description: Meta WhatsApp Business API, Razorpay and PhonePe payments, and LLM-powered features such as document summarization, all of which I have run in production.

services.title: Google and AI search visibility
services.description: Server-rendered pages, structured data, sitemaps, robots.txt and llms.txt, so your site can be read by Google and by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity.

process.title: Tell me about your project
process.description: Email me what your business does and what you need. We then have a short call to go through your goals, pages and features.

process.title: Get a written scope and quote
process.description: I send a written scope, timeline and price before any work starts, so you know exactly what you are getting.

process.title: Review as it is built
process.description: You get a live preview link while I build, so you can review pages and ask for changes along the way.

process.title: Launch
process.description: I connect your domain, deploy the site, and set up the sitemap and analytics so it is ready for visitors and search engines.

faq.question: How much does a website cost?
faq.answer: It depends on the number of pages and features you need. After a short call, I send a written quote with a fixed scope and timeline before any work starts, so there are no surprises.

faq.question: Do you work with businesses in any industry?
faq.answer: Yes. I have built websites, web apps and mobile apps for real estate firms, an accounting and compliance firm, a performance marketing agency, a vehicle service center, a hospital, a healthcare SaaS platform and an artist-booking marketplace. What matters is understanding the problem you need solved, not the industry.

faq.question: Will my website show up on Google?
faq.answer: Every site I build is server-rendered, fast and mobile-friendly, with page titles, descriptions, structured data and a sitemap set up, which is what search engines need to read it. Your ranking also depends on your content and competition, so no one can honestly guarantee a position.

faq.question: What technology do you use?
faq.answer: For websites I mostly use Next.js and Tailwind CSS. For web apps and SaaS I use React, Node.js, PostgreSQL or MySQL, and AWS, and for mobile apps React Native. I choose the simplest setup that solves the problem well.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Email me at vnikhil3101@gmail.com with a few lines about your business and what you need. I will reply to set up a short call.

servicesIntro: Whatever your industry, I start from the problem you need solved, then build the right thing for it: a website, a web app, a mobile app or a SaaS product.
